name: Indigotine
aliases: E132, INS 132, indigotine, indigo carmine, FD&C Blue No. 2, FD&C Blue 2, Blue 2
what_is: A synthetic certified food colour known as Indigotine and declared under different names or numbering systems depending on the market.
why_botia: Indigotine is barely absorbed in the intestine: most of it passes through. It appears on the European Union list of authorised food colours as E132, and in the United States it is known as FD&C Blue No. 2. JECFA established an acceptable daily intake and found no health concern at estimated dietary exposure; in the United States, several companies have committed to removing petroleum-based food dyes.
